title: Delivery Gate Separation Plan
description: Machine-readable plan for safely separating an exact set of uncommitted changes from one worktree to a dedicated branch and worktree. All fields with default safe values are explicit to prevent ambiguous defaults.

schema_version.description: Separation plan schema version. Must be '1.0'.

operation_id.description: Unique identifier for this separation operation.

source_worktree.description: Absolute path to the source worktree (must be realpath, no symlinks, no traversal).

destination_worktree.description: Absolute path for the new dedicated worktree (must not already exist).

destination_branch.description: Branch name for the dedicated worktree (must not already exist).

expected_head.description: Expected HEAD SHA of source_worktree before separation. Enforced as exact equality (CAS precondition).

expected_origin.description: Expected origin/main SHA at separation time. Verified before any mutation.

exact_paths.description: Exact set of relative paths to separate. Must match actual dirty paths exactly (allowlist equality). No path traversal, no absolute paths, no newline characters.

expected_path_count.description: Expected count of exact_paths. Must equal length of exact_paths array.

include_untracked.description: Include untracked files in the stash. Default: false.

external_hash_manifest.description: Optional absolute path to an existing SHA-256 hash manifest file to verify current state against before separation. If set, must match current working tree files exactly.

preserve_existing_backup.description: Never overwrite or delete an existing external backup. Default: true (safe).

stash_message.description: Message for the transfer stash. Used to identify the stash by message.

commit_allowed.description: Whether a commit may be created during separation. Default: false (safe).

push_allowed.description: Whether a push may be executed during separation. Default: false (safe).

remove_source_changes.description: Whether to remove the separated changes from source_worktree after verified restoration. Default: true (stash created, changes removed from source).

drop_stash_after_verified_restore.description: Whether to drop the transfer stash after exact restoration is proven. Default: false (safe — manual drop required after independent verification).

required_hash_match.description: Whether SHA-256 equality between pre-separation and restored manifests is required before any stash drop. Default: true (safe).

example.description: Example separation plan for a carousel/instagram workstream

value.stash_message: transfer: carousel and instagram work to dedicated worktree
